970c0f97fc.q: How does TwinOneAI create digital twins that preserve privacy and governance boundaries while scaling knowledge across organizations?
970c0f97fc.a: TwinOneAI creates digital twins in two core pieces: first, a model of your knowledge, judgment, decision-making, and real-time working context; second, trust and governance around you that maps every relationship and distills that judgment into the AI. The company employs seven layers of interlocking rules-based and AI-based privacy filters covering PII, health information, GDPR compliance, and relationship-specific sharing calibrated on previous interactions, plus hard deterministic rails that AI cannot circumvent.
970c0f97fc.e: What If AI Could Clone You at Work?
970c0f97fc.rq: We want to make sure that Megan is always available, and we want to make sure Megan continues to do her good job. Instead of hiring a junior compliance person, there's 10 Megans because Megan has a digital twin.

b0a5a19529.q: What is the inspiration behind TwinOneAI and how did Louis Liu transition from Eigen Technologies to founding the company?
b0a5a19529.a: The inspiration came from unfinished business at Eigen—the realization that while AI was solving 5% of the problem by digitizing contracts, people really needed to know the negotiation pathway and conditions that led to outcomes. Liu also drew inspiration from a Star Trek Next Generation episode where a digital twin of an engineer helped solve a crisis. After selling Eigen about two years before founding TwinOneAI, Liu used his experience as a second-time founder to quickly build a prototype, recruit trusted collaborators, and validate the thesis with early customers.

befd417cf3.q: How does TwinOneAI solve the problem of agentic drift and AI alignment in enterprise adoption?
befd417cf3.a: TwinOneAI addresses agentic drift through its MCP server architecture: when an AI agent interacts with a digital twin, the same privacy and trust boundary conditions apply as with human interactions. The digital twin acts as a manifestation of the human in the agentic realm, coaching other agents while respecting the human's preferences, eliminating the need for constant human supervision of long-horizon agents.

e5d7d38a95.q: Which credit unions are already using TwinOneAI and what challenges do credit unions face in AI adoption?
e5d7d38a95.a: Shoreline Credit Union in Wisconsin is one of TwinOneAI's first credit union customers. Credit unions typically lack massive IT teams compared to large banks, operate with lean compliance and legal staff (often just one officer per function), and face pressure during staff absences. TwinOneAI's product is designed to make deployment easy for organizations with limited technical sophistication or IT resources.
